environment.description: AWS Lambda authorizer running in account 555666777888 within an AWS Organization (OU: ou-abc1-workloads). The Lambda execution role (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/AuthorizerLambdaRole) has an attached IAM permission boundary policy (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/LambdaAuthorzerBoundary) that contains an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole for any resource matching arn:aws:iam::*:role/Admin*. Additionally, the organizational unit has SCP 'RestrictPrivilegeEscalation' (p-xyzabc123) attached which includes a Deny statement for sts:AssumeRole with a StringNotEquals condition on aws:PrincipalOrgID unless the session name matches the pattern 'scheduled-rotation-*'. The AdminOperationsRole trust policy requires aws:PrincipalTag/team to equal 'platform-sre' which is not present on the Lambda execution role's session tags. JWT_PUBLIC_KEY environment variable contains the same RSA public key in PEM format.

config.scp_condition: StringNotEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID unless session name matches scheduled-rotation-*
